text: acidflow: build `cmake --build build --target acidflow -j12` (binary build/acidflow), tests `ctest --test-dir build -LE perf`; Windows check = cross-build in /tmp with -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/llvm-mingw.cmake -DLLVM_MINGW=~/.local/opt/llvm-mingw and run the test .exe files under wine (WINEDEBUG=-all); pty smoke = /tmp/pyte-venv/bin/python ../maya/tests/smoke.py build/acidflow.
